points.p: and（和）、but（但是）、or（或）、so（所以）、yet（然而）、for（因為，書面）、nor（也不）。連接地位一樣的字、片語或句子。

ex.en: I was sick, so I stayed home.
ex.zh: 我生病了，所以待在家。

ex.en: Do you want tea or coffee?
ex.zh: 你要茶還是咖啡？

points.t: 連接兩個完整句子時加逗號
points.p: 兩邊都有主詞和動詞時，連接詞前面通常加逗號：I was tired, but I finished my work.

ex.en: I was tired, but I finished my work.
ex.zh: 我很累，但還是把工作做完了。

ex.en: The test was hard, yet everyone passed.
ex.zh: 考試很難，然而大家都過了。

points.p: 連接的東西形式要一樣：She likes swimming and running.（不說 swimming and to run）

ex.en: She likes swimming and running.
ex.zh: 她喜歡游泳和跑步。

ex.en: The nurse was kind and patient.
ex.zh: 那位護理師親切又有耐心。

mistakes.bad: She likes reading and to swim.
mistakes.why: and 前後的形式要一樣。

drills.q: I was sick, ___ I stayed home.
drills.why: 前面是原因、後面是結果，用 so。

drills.q: Do you want tea ___ coffee?
drills.why: 二選一用 or。

drills.q: I like singing and to dance.
accept: I like singing and dancing.
I like to sing and to dance.
I like to sing and dance.
drills.why: and 前後的形式要一樣：singing and dancing。

points.t: 從屬連接詞帶出附屬的子句
points.p: because、although、when、if、while、before、after、until、since、unless 帶出的子句不能自己成為一句，要接一個主要句子。

ex.en: I'll call you when I arrive.
ex.zh: 我到了會打給你。

ex.en: If you feel dizzy, sit down.
ex.zh: 如果覺得頭暈，就坐下來。

points.t: 放前面加逗號，放後面不用
points.p: When I got home, I took a shower.／I took a shower when I got home.

ex.en: When I got home, I took a shower.
ex.zh: 我回到家就去洗澡。

ex.en: I took a shower when I got home.
ex.zh: 我回到家就去洗澡。

mistakes.bad: Because it was raining. We stayed home.
mistakes.good: Because it was raining, we stayed home.
mistakes.why: because 帶出的子句不能單獨成句，要跟主要句子接在一起。

drills.q: ___ I got home, I took a shower.
drills.why: 說時間的子句，用 when。

drills.q: Don't leave ___ the doctor comes.
drills.why: 「直到醫生來」用 until。

drills.q: I'll wait here until you will come back.
accept: I'll wait here until you come back.
drills.why: until、when 這類時間子句用現在式表示未來，不用 will。

points.p: Both my parents are nurses. 主詞是 both A and B 時，動詞用複數。

ex.en: Both my parents are nurses.
ex.zh: 我爸媽都是護理師。

ex.en: She speaks both English and Japanese.
ex.zh: 她英文和日文都會說。

points.t: either A or B、neither A nor B
points.p: either ... or（兩個之一）、neither ... nor（兩個都不）。動詞跟比較近的 B 一致：Neither the doctor nor the nurses were there.

ex.en: You can have either tea or coffee.
ex.zh: 你可以喝茶或咖啡（選一個）。

ex.en: Neither the doctor nor the nurses were there.
ex.zh: 醫生和護理師都不在。

mistakes.bad: Neither my brother or my sister likes coffee.
mistakes.good: Neither my brother nor my sister likes coffee.
mistakes.why: neither 配 nor，either 才配 or。

drills.q: ___ Tom and Amy are nurses.
drills.why: 配 and 的是 both。

drills.q: You can have either tea ___ coffee.
drills.why: either 配 or。

drills.q: Neither my mom or my dad can drive.
accept: Neither my mom nor my dad can drive.
drills.why: neither 配 nor。

points.t: not only A but (also) B：不但……而且……
points.p: A 和 B 形式要對等：She is not only smart but also kind.

ex.en: She is not only smart but also kind.
ex.zh: 她不但聰明而且親切。

ex.en: She speaks not only English but also Japanese.
ex.zh: 她不只會說英文，還會說日文。

points.p: Not only the students but also the teacher was late.

ex.en: Not only the students but also the teacher was late.
ex.zh: 不只學生，連老師都遲到了。

ex.en: The patient as well as his parents was worried.
ex.zh: 病人和他的父母都很擔心。

points.t: Not only 放句首要倒裝
points.p: Not only did she pass, but she also got the highest score.

ex.en: Not only did she pass, but she also got the highest score.
ex.zh: 她不但通過了，還拿到最高分。

ex.en: Not only is he a doctor, but he is also a writer.
ex.zh: 他不但是醫生，還是作家。

mistakes.bad: She not only speaks English but also Japanese.
mistakes.good: She speaks not only English but also Japanese.
mistakes.why: not only 和 but also 後面要放同樣形式的東西（English／Japanese）。

drills.q: He is not only a doctor ___ a writer.
drills.why: not only 配 but also。

drills.q: Not only the students but also the teacher ___ late.
drills.why: 動詞跟比較近的 the teacher 一致，用 was。

drills.q: Not only she is smart, but she is also kind.
accept: Not only is she smart, but she is also kind.
drills.why: Not only 放句首要倒裝：is she。

points.t: 連接詞可以用逗號接兩句
points.p: and、but、so、because 是連接詞：It was late, but we kept working.

ex.en: It was late, but we kept working.
ex.zh: 很晚了，但我們繼續工作。

ex.en: I was sick, so I stayed home.
ex.zh: 我生病了，所以待在家。

points.p: however、therefore、moreover 是副詞，兩句之間要用句號或分號：It was late; however, we kept working.

ex.en: It was late; however, we kept working.
ex.zh: 很晚了，不過我們繼續工作。

ex.en: I was sick. Therefore, I stayed home.
ex.zh: 我生病了，因此待在家。

table.title: 意思相近，用法不同：連接詞可以用逗號接兩句，連接副詞要用句號或分號
head: 意思
連接詞
連接副詞

mistakes.bad: I was sick, therefore I stayed home.
mistakes.good: I was sick, so I stayed home.
mistakes.why: therefore 不能用逗號接兩句；改用 so，或寫成 I was sick; therefore, I stayed home.

drills.q: It was raining, ___ we went out anyway.
drills.why: 用逗號接兩句，只能用連接詞 but。

drills.q: The test was hard. ___, most students passed.
drills.why: 句號後面接連接副詞 however。

drills.q: However it was raining, we went out.
accept: Although it was raining, we went out.
Though it was raining, we went out.
Even though it was raining, we went out.
drills.why: however 不能帶出子句；「雖然」要用 although。

points.p: and、also、too、as well、besides、in addition、moreover、furthermore，用來加更多資訊。

ex.en: The room is clean. Moreover, it's very quiet.
ex.zh: 房間很乾淨，而且很安靜。

ex.en: She is kind, and she is also very patient.
ex.zh: 她很親切，也很有耐心。

points.p: In addition to English, she speaks Korean.／Besides working, she takes care of her kids.

ex.en: In addition to English, she speaks Korean.
ex.zh: 除了英文，她還會說韓文。

ex.en: Besides working, she takes care of her kids.
ex.zh: 除了工作，她還要照顧小孩。

mistakes.bad: In addition to speak English, she speaks Korean.
mistakes.good: In addition to speaking English, she speaks Korean.
mistakes.why: in addition to 的 to 是介系詞，後面用 V-ing。

drills.q: The room is clean. ___, it's very quiet.
drills.why: 再加上一個優點，用 moreover。

drills.q: ___ to English, she speaks Korean.
drills.why: In addition to＋名詞；besides 後面不加 to。

drills.q: Besides to work, she takes care of her kids.
accept: Besides working, she takes care of her kids.
Besides work, she takes care of her kids.
In addition to working, she takes care of her kids.
drills.why: besides 後面直接接名詞或 V-ing。

points.p: but、however、while、whereas、on the other hand：I like coffee, while my sister likes tea.

ex.en: I like coffee, while my sister likes tea.
ex.zh: 我喜歡咖啡，而我妹妹喜歡茶。

ex.en: The job is hard. On the other hand, the pay is good.
ex.zh: 工作很辛苦，但另一方面薪水不錯。

points.p: although／though／even though＋句子；despite／in spite of＋名詞或 V-ing。

ex.en: Although it was raining, we went out.
ex.zh: 雖然在下雨，我們還是出門了。

ex.en: Despite the rain, we went out.
ex.zh: 儘管下雨，我們還是出門了。

mistakes.bad: Despite it was raining, we went out.
mistakes.good: Although it was raining, we went out.
mistakes.why: despite 後面接名詞；接句子要用 although。

drills.q: ___ she was tired, she kept working.
drills.why: 後面是句子，用 although。

drills.q: We went out ___ the rain.
drills.why: 後面是名詞 the rain，用 despite。

drills.q: In spite of he was sick, he went to work.
accept: Although he was sick, he went to work.
Though he was sick, he went to work.
Even though he was sick, he went to work.
In spite of being sick, he went to work.
Despite being sick, he went to work.
drills.why: in spite of 後面不接句子；改用 although，或說 in spite of being sick。

points.p: because、since、as＋句子；because of、due to＋名詞：I stayed home because I was sick.

ex.en: I stayed home because I was sick.
ex.zh: 我因為生病待在家。

ex.en: The class was canceled due to the typhoon.
ex.zh: 課因為颱風取消了。

points.p: so、therefore、as a result；so＋形容詞＋that、such＋名詞＋that：It was so cold that we stayed inside.

ex.en: It was so cold that we stayed inside.
ex.zh: 冷到我們都待在室內。

ex.en: It was such a long day that I fell asleep at eight.
ex.zh: 那天太累了，我八點就睡著了。

points.p: so that＋句子；to／in order to＋原形：I left early so that I could catch the bus.／I left early to catch the bus.

ex.en: I left early so that I could catch the bus.
ex.zh: 我提早出門，好趕上公車。

ex.en: I left early to catch the bus.
ex.zh: 我提早出門去趕公車。

mistakes.bad: I study hard so that pass the exam.
mistakes.good: I study hard so that I can pass the exam.
mistakes.why: so that 後面要接完整的句子；或說 to pass the exam。

drills.q: It was ___ cold that we stayed inside.
drills.why: so＋形容詞＋that。

drills.q: I left early ___ I could catch the first bus.
drills.why: 為了趕上公車，用 so that。

drills.q: It was such hot that I couldn't sleep.
accept: It was so hot that I couldn't sleep.
drills.why: 形容詞前面用 so；such 後面接名詞。

points.p: when、while、before、after、as soon as、until、since、once：When she arrived, we started the meeting.

ex.en: When she arrived, we started the meeting.
ex.zh: 她一到，我們就開始開會。

ex.en: Wash your hands before you eat.
ex.zh: 吃東西前先洗手。

points.t: 時間子句用現在式說未來
points.p: I'll call you when I arrive.（不說 when I will arrive）

ex.en: I'll call you when I arrive.
ex.zh: 我到了會打給你。

ex.en: As soon as the results come out, I'll let you know.
ex.zh: 結果一出來我就通知你。

points.p: While I was cooking, the phone rang.（煮飯的時候電話響了）

ex.en: While I was cooking, the phone rang.
ex.zh: 我在煮飯的時候電話響了。

ex.en: She fell asleep while she was reading.
ex.zh: 她看書看到睡著了。

mistakes.bad: I'll call you when I will get home.
mistakes.good: I'll call you when I get home.
mistakes.why: 時間子句用現在式表示未來。

drills.q: ___ I was cooking, the phone rang.
drills.why: 正在做某事的時候，用 while。

drills.q: Wait here ___ I come back.
drills.why: 「等到我回來」用 until。

drills.q: As soon as I will finish, I'll call you.
accept: As soon as I finish, I'll call you.
drills.why: 時間子句用現在式，不用 will。

points.p: if（如果）、unless（除非）、as long as（只要）、in case（以防萬一）：You can go out as long as you finish your homework.

ex.en: You can go out as long as you finish your homework.
ex.zh: 只要寫完功課，你就可以出去。

ex.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
ex.zh: 帶把傘，以防下雨。

points.p: unless＝if ... not，後面不再加 not：Unless you hurry, you'll be late.

ex.en: Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
ex.zh: 除非你快一點，不然會遲到。

ex.en: Don't take this medicine unless the doctor says so.
ex.zh: 除非醫生說可以，不然不要吃這個藥。

points.p: or、either ... or、otherwise：Hurry up, or you'll miss the bus.

ex.en: Hurry up, or you'll miss the bus.
ex.zh: 快一點，不然你會錯過公車。

ex.en: Rest well; otherwise, you won't recover.
ex.zh: 好好休息，否則你不會康復。

mistakes.bad: Unless you don't hurry, you'll be late.
mistakes.good: Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
mistakes.why: unless 本身就有否定的意思，不再加 don't。

drills.q: Take an umbrella ___ it rains.
drills.why: 以防下雨，用 in case。

drills.q: Hurry up, ___ you'll be late.
drills.why: 「不然」用 or。

drills.q: You can't come in unless you don't have a ticket.
accept: You can't come in unless you have a ticket.
drills.why: unless 後面不再加否定。

points.p: 因為：As it was late, we went home.；當……時：As I was leaving, it started to rain.；像：Do as I say.

ex.en: As it was late, we went home.
ex.zh: 因為很晚了，我們就回家了。

ex.en: As I was leaving, it started to rain.
ex.zh: 我要離開的時候開始下雨了。

points.p: 自從（配完成式）：I have lived here since I was ten.；因為：Since you're here, let's start.

ex.en: I have lived here since I was ten.
ex.zh: 我從十歲就住在這裡。

ex.en: Since you're here, let's start.
ex.zh: 既然你來了，我們開始吧。

points.p: 當……時：While I was cooking, ...；然而（對比）：I like tea, while my sister likes coffee.

ex.en: While I was cooking, the phone rang.
ex.zh: 我在煮飯時電話響了。

ex.en: I like tea, while my sister likes coffee.
ex.zh: 我喜歡茶，而我妹妹喜歡咖啡。

table.title: 一個字，好幾種意思
head: 字
意思
例子
rows: while I was cooking／while she likes coffee

mistakes.bad: Since I moved here, I lived alone.
mistakes.good: Since I moved here, I have lived alone.
mistakes.why: since 是「自從」時，主要的句子用現在完成式。

drills.q: 「Since you're busy, I'll come back later.」的 since 是 ___。
drills.why: 你在忙，所以我晚點再來：since 是「因為」。

drills.q: 「I like tea, while my sister likes coffee.」的 while 是 ___。
drills.why: 前後在對比，while 是「然而」。

drills.q: I have known her since we are children.
accept: I have known her since we were children.
drills.why: since 後面接過去的起點，用過去式 were。

points.p: 後面要有主詞和動詞：because it rained／although she was tired。

ex.en: We stayed home because it was raining.
ex.zh: 因為下雨，我們待在家。

ex.en: Although she was tired, she kept working.
ex.zh: 雖然很累，她還是繼續工作。

points.t: 接名詞或 V-ing：because of、despite、in spite of
points.p: because of the rain／despite the rain／despite being tired。

ex.en: We stayed home because of the rain.
ex.zh: 因為下雨，我們待在家。

ex.en: Despite being tired, she kept working.
ex.zh: 儘管很累，她還是繼續工作。

mistakes.bad: Because of it was raining, we stayed home.
mistakes.good: Because it was raining, we stayed home.
mistakes.why: 後面是句子，用 because；because of 後面接名詞。

drills.q: The game was canceled ___ the storm.
drills.why: 後面是名詞 the storm，用 because of。

drills.q: ___ being tired, she finished the report.
drills.why: 後面是 V-ing，用 despite。

drills.q: Although the bad weather, we went hiking.
accept: Despite the bad weather, we went hiking.
In spite of the bad weather, we went hiking.
drills.why: 後面是名詞，用 despite 或 in spite of。

points.p: 對等連接詞連兩句，主詞相同可以省略後面的主詞，也不用逗號：I finished my shift and went home.

ex.en: I finished my shift and went home.
ex.zh: 我下班後就回家了。

ex.en: She called the doctor but didn't get an answer.
ex.zh: 她打給醫生，但沒人接。

points.p: 放前面加逗號：If you need help, call me.；放後面通常不加：Call me if you need help.

ex.en: If you need help, call me.
ex.zh: 需要幫忙就打給我。

ex.en: Call me if you need help.
ex.zh: 需要幫忙就打給我。

points.t: 主詞相同時子句可以縮短
points.p: While (I was) waiting, I read a book. 縮短的前提是兩邊主詞一樣，不然意思會錯。

ex.en: While waiting for the bus, I read a book.
ex.zh: 等公車的時候我看了一本書。

ex.en: When I was eating, the phone rang.
ex.zh: 我在吃飯時電話響了。

mistakes.bad: When eating, the phone rang.（想說我吃飯時電話響了）
mistakes.good: When I was eating, the phone rang.
mistakes.why: 縮短後主詞變成 the phone，好像是電話在吃飯；主詞不同時不能縮短。

drills.q: ___ you need help, call me.
drills.why: 條件子句放前面，用 if，後面加逗號。

drills.q: While ___ for the bus, I read a book.
drills.why: 主詞相同時縮短成 while＋V-ing。

drills.q: While walking home, the rain started.
accept: While I was walking home, the rain started.
While I was walking home, it started to rain.
While I was walking home, it started raining.
drills.why: 主詞不同（我走路、雨開始下），不能縮短，要把 I was 補回來。

points.t: 雖然……但是：英文只用一個
points.p: 中文說「雖然……但是」「因為……所以」，英文 although 和 but、because 和 so 只能選一個。

ex.en: Although it was late, we kept working.
ex.zh: 雖然很晚了，我們還是繼續工作。

ex.en: Because I was sick, I stayed home.
ex.zh: 因為生病，所以我待在家。

points.t: 兩個句子不能只用逗號接
points.p: 中文常用逗號一路接下去，英文兩個完整句子之間要有連接詞，或用句號分開：I was tired, so I went to bed.／I was tired. I went to bed.

ex.en: I was tired, so I went to bed.
ex.zh: 我很累，所以去睡了。

ex.en: I was tired. I went to bed early.
ex.zh: 我很累，早早就去睡了。

mistakes.bad: Although it was raining, but we went out.
mistakes.good: Although it was raining, we went out.
mistakes.why: although 和 but 只能用一個。

drills.q: Because I was sick, ___ stayed home.
drills.why: 前面已經有 because，後面不再加 so。

drills.q: I was tired, ___ I went to bed early.
drills.why: 兩個句子要有連接詞，表示結果用 so。

drills.q: Although he is rich, but he is not happy.
accept: Although he is rich, he is not happy.
He is rich, but he is not happy.
drills.why: although 和 but 只能用一個。
